Name: AllyAnim
Description: The move plays its animation when used on an ally.

Name: BypassSub
Description: Ignores a target's substitute.

Name: Bite
Description: Power is multiplied by 1.5 when used by a Pokemon with the Ability Strong Jaw.

Name: Bullet
Description: Has no effect on Pokemon with the Ability Bulletproof.

Name: CantUseTwice
Description: The user cannot select this move after a previous successful use.

Name: Charge
Description: The user is unable to make a move between turns.

Name: Contact
Description: Makes contact.

Name: Dance
Description: When used by a Pokemon, other Pokemon with the Ability Dancer can attempt to execute the same move.

Name: Defrost
Description: Thaws the user if executed successfully while the user is frozen.

Name: Distance
Description: Can target a Pokemon positioned anywhere in a Triple Battle.

Name: FailCopycat
Description: Cannot be selected by Copycat.

Name: FailEncore
Description: Encore fails if the target used this move.

Name: FailInstruct
Description: Cannot be repeated by Instruct.

Name: FailMeFirst
Description: Cannot be selected by Me First.

Name: FailMimic
Description: Cannot be copied by Mimic.

Name: FutureMove
Description: Targets a slot, and in 2 turns damages that slot.

Name: Gravity
Description: Prevented from being executed or selected during Gravity's effect.

Name: Heal
Description: Prevented from being executed or selected during Heal Block's effect.

Name: Metronome
Description: Can be selected by Metronome.

Name: Minimize
Description: Deals double damage if the user is minimized.

Name: Mirror
Description: Can be copied by Mirror Move.

Name: MustPressure
Description: Additional PP is deducted due to Pressure when it ordinarily would not.

Name: NoAssist
Description: Cannot be selected by Assist.

Name: NonSky
Description: Prevented from being executed or selected in a Sky Battle.

Name: NoParentalBond
Description: Cannot be made to hit twice via Parental Bond.

Name: NoSketch
Description: Cannot be copied by Sketch.

Name: NoSleepTalk
Description: Cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

Name: PledgeCombo
Description: Gems will not activate. Cannot be redirected by Storm Drain / Lightning Rod.

Name: Powder
Description: Has no effect on Pokemon which are Grass-type, have the Ability Overcoat, or hold Safety Goggles.

Name: Protect
Description: Blocked by Detect, Protect, Spiky Shield, and if not a Status move, King's Shield.

Name: Pulse
Description: Power is multiplied by 1.5 when used by a Pokemon with the Ability Mega Launcher.

Name: Punch
Description: Power is multiplied by 1.2 when used by a Pokemon with the Ability Iron Fist.

Name: Recharge
Description: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot make a move.

Name: Reflectable
Description: Bounced back to the original user by Magic Coat or the Ability Magic Bounce.

Name: Slicing
Description: Power is multiplied by 1.5 when used by a Pokemon with the Ability Sharpness.

Name: Snatch
Description: Can be stolen from the original user and instead used by another Pokemon using Snatch.

Name: Sound
Description: Has no effect on Pokemon with the Ability Soundproof.

Name: Wind
Description: Activates the Wind Power and Wind Rider Abilities.

Name: FieldMove
Description: Can be used outside of battle.
